name: KRWO
oneLiner: KRWO is a Korean won-pegged stablecoin issued by Gimswap against Open Voucher KRW vouchers at a 10,000:1 ratio; multi-chain ERC-20 with minter privileges.
collateral: Open Voucher (OV) KRW vouchers issued by Open Asset and represented on-chain as OV tokens used as collateral for KRWO issuance
pegMechanism: KRWO is issued against OV tokens at a 10,000 KRWO = 1 OV token/voucher ratio; Open Voucher documentation describes OV vouchers as redeemable for Korean won at 1:1 through the Open Voucher service

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Verified BSC FiatToken source exposes privileged mint authority but no direct holder freeze, blacklist, pause, seize, or arbitrary role-burn function. KRWO is backed by Open Voucher/KRW redemption rails, so FreezeWatch resolves upstream backing/redemption blocking exposure.

mintAuthority.summary: KRWO is a non-upgradeable Ownable ERC-20 (not a FiatToken) on both BSC and Klaytn/Kaia. On BSC the owner is EOA 0xc34e0d2b73e5c5a826fa4a86c240cac9fd347c1c; on Klaytn the owner is a distinct EOA 0xbe025edc4499c0e50a2c14655ba360a840f47c39. No multisig or timelock; single-EOA custody on each chain warrants unbounded-or-compromised posture.

controls.label: KRWO owner (BSC) — EOA
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103,631,986, owner() returned 0xc34e0d2b73e5c5a826fa4a86c240cac9fd347c1c; eth_getCode returned 0x (EOA). EIP-1967 proxy slots are zero — non-upgradeable. masterMinter() reverts; contract is a simple Ownable ERC-20, not FiatToken.

controls.label: KRWO owner (Klaytn/Kaia) — EOA
controls.evidence: At Klaytn/Kaia block 218,849,661, owner() returned 0xbe025edc4499c0e50a2c14655ba360a840f47c39; eth_getCode returned 0x (EOA). Non-upgradeable. masterMinter() reverts — same simple Ownable pattern as BSC.

review.evidence: At BSC block 103,631,986 and Klaytn block 218,849,661: both KRWO deployments are non-upgradeable Ownable ERC-20s. BSC owner is EOA 0xc34e0d2b73e5c5a826fa4a86c240cac9fd347c1c; Klaytn owner is EOA 0xbe025edc4499c0e50a2c14655ba360a840f47c39. masterMinter() reverts on both — prior 'FiatToken' characterization was inaccurate. Single-EOA ownership on both chains with no multisig or timelock; posture remains unbounded-or-compromised.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: GimSwap docs describe KRWO as issued on Kaia and BNB networks to enable Korean-won transactions. The source evidence supports issuer-native multichain issuance rather than an external bridge route.
